prompt: Connect to Vintrace and tell me the current image action count and maximum fetch batch. Use the minimum calls needed.
How many assets are in my Vintrace library, and are there any active image jobs? Do not inspect files or pixels.
Find the five images matching the exact terms golden needle amber lighthouse SN-1042. Return only stable asset IDs and titles; do not request previews.
Find up to 20 favorite red bicycle product images. Use exact metadata filtering and return stable IDs without pixels.
Find cobalt prototype portfolio images, then fetch structured metadata for the top three stable IDs. Do not request previews.
Find the golden needle SN-1042 images and report existing OCR, object, barcode, quality, and metadata intelligence for them. Do not run indexing and do not request pixels.
Find one studio portrait Alice image and show exactly one bounded preview at no more than 768 pixels. Do not preview any other asset.
What reusable Vintrace image workflow recipes are available? Give names and approval counts only.
Plan the built-in portfolio curation recipe for query cobalt prototype with at most 12 candidates. Do not execute any step.
Find one green mountain hike image and plan changing its title to Reviewed mountain select. Do not perform the write.

Find one wildlife fox image, plan changing its title to Agent reviewed fox, then perform that non-destructive write. I explicitly confirm this write. Use idempotency key dogfood-{client}-metadata-v1 and verify the result without requesting pixels.
Plan and create an empty manual album named Dogfood {client} Selects. I explicitly confirm this non-destructive metadata write. Use idempotency key dogfood-{client}-album-v1. Do not add assets.

Find the five golden needle amber lighthouse images, plan a PNG contact sheet titled Dogfood {client} Needles with two columns and no captions, then create it. I explicitly confirm this non-destructive export. Use idempotency key dogfood-{client}-contact-sheet-v1. Return the operation or manifest identifier, never a filesystem path.
List recent Vintrace agent-write and export operations, then inspect the newest matching operation and summarize its path-free manifest.
List the inbound visual sources the operator has authorized. Do not connect, discover remote items, or import anything.
Find document archive images, inspect whether text, objects, and barcodes are already indexed, and if anything is missing plan the appropriate indexing action. Do not start the job.
Inspect Vintrace image-library health and plan a dry-run catalog cleanup. Do not execute any mutation.
Summarize recent Vintrace agent approvals, failures, replays, and pixel disclosures using the agent activity feed only.
